searchText: MSRP $137,231. New 2026 East to West Entrada Class C RV from Forest River. The 2710NK measures approximately 29 feet 11 inches in length. Features Entrada Value Package Roof Mounted 12V Solar Panel Automatic Leveling Jacks More About This RV You will find the Entrada Value Package boasting a 40' LED TV, Large Refrigerator, Black Tank Flush, One-Piece Molded Fiberglass Front Cap, Power Awning with LED Light Strip, Backup and Side View Cameras with Monitor, Hitch, Tank Heaters, and the Winegard® Air 360+ Antenna. Additional stand-out features include 50 amp service paired with a dual A/C configuration with a 15K BTU A/C with heat pump in the living and 13.5K BTU A/C in the bedroom. NPS 5.5KW Yamaha generator, Hardwood Shaker Style Cabinets, 12-Volt Exhaust Fan and Light, 2' Sidewall with Azdel® Composite Backing, twin bed king conversion, Rotocast Storage Compartments, Walk Around Queen Bed on All Floor Plans, 1.3 Cubic ft. Convection Microwave Oven, One Piece Cold Resistant Flooring, Dicor® Diflex II TPO Roof, 7' Interior Living Height, Aluminum Running Boards, Integrated Entry Step, and the Entrada is a Completely Laminated Coach!! East to West is a division of Forest River. East to West takes pride in the five guiding principles and corporate philosophy which focuses on people working together to create high-quality, value-added products that deliver the ultimate RV experience. You’ll find all of this and much more in each Entrada built.
